images.prompt: Keeper of Hours — ADVANCED (end-game) identity master, male, register H1. THE CHARACTER — Keeper of Hours, ADVANCED (end-game) set, a MAN in his late thirties: weathered sun-browned face, cropped dark beard, dark hair cut short, a scar through one eyebrow, a calm hard-won authority; broad shoulders, a man's proportions. Gear (every item an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt under a navy wool tabard, over it a chestnut leather cuirass with brass edge-trim closed at the chest by a BRASS RING bearing a single HOUR-MARK (the Keepers' advanced sigil — the only emblem on him, repeated once as the staff head); a hooded navy wool mantle thrown back; heavy chestnut leather bracers with brass studs; a chestnut harness strap from the right shoulder to the LEFT hip carrying an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners and a brass-capped ledger case; chestnut belt with a brass buckle; navy trousers; chestnut boots with brass-buckled greaves. Staff: dark walnut shaft, brass ferrule at the foot, and at the head a BRASS RING with an hour-mark cradling a small hour-glass crystal that gives off a faint COLD blue-white glow — the only spell light in the scene. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing in a ready stance, weight even, feet visible, staff planted upright in the RIGHT hand. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; the staff crystal's faint cold glow is the only spell light; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte.
